Dopina / CRM

Dopina.
One less thing on your mind.

Email, WhatsApp, SMS and phone.
One customer history.

Dopina CRM organises customer service in companies where sales involve agreeing details, preparing a quote and following up. It links each case to its owner, conversation history, deadlines and the team's work.

Email, WhatsApp Business, SMS and a helpline are included in the CRM core. We connect the company's accounts and adapt the workflow to the team. The system is used by STAGO — a manufacturer of modular pavilions.

Implementation scope
CaseInboxDashboardIntegrationsImplementation scopeFull feature list

Who it is for

Sales that call for
conversation and agreed details.

For manufacturers, distributors and service companies where several people work with each customer, quotes follow their own rules, and agreed details must be passed on for fulfilment. Especially when key information is scattered across email, spreadsheets and messaging apps.

We adapt stages, responsibilities and on-screen information to how the company works. Sales staff see their own contacts, while managers see the status of cases and where action is needed.

Everyday work

One case.
From message to decision.

A customer emails, then calls, then returns on WhatsApp. The team links these conversations to the case, checks what was agreed and plans the next contact.

  1. 01

    Receive the enquiry

    A message or call comes in for handling. You check whether it relates to an existing case.

  2. 02

    Link it to the customer

    You assign the conversation to a case and its owner. The agreed details stay with the customer.

  3. 03

    Prepare a reply

    You return to the history and notes. AI can prepare a summary or draft for review.

  4. 04

    Set the next step

    You save a date, task or agreed sequence. You know what to come back to tomorrow.

01 / Customer service

Agreed details stay
with the case.

Each enquiry has an owner, a stage and a next action. Before a conversation, you return to the history, notes and existing quotes. The list shows which contacts are overdue.

The views show fictional companies, people and amounts. We confirm the implementation scope separately.

You know who is responsible

Responsibilities and data access depend on the role. Whoever takes over the contact has a starting point for reviewing agreed details, while managers see the state of sales and where action is needed.

A quote can lead to the next stage

The quote configurator, acceptance and handover to production are extensions. We agree their rules before they become part of the process.

02 / Team inbox

Every conversation has a history.
And the right context.

You connect personal or company email, WhatsApp Business, SMS and a helpline. You can link the conversation to a customer case and see its owner, status, latest notes and quotes alongside it.

Manage multiple inboxes

Account selection, filters, unread messages, flagged messages, archive and drafts. New messages, replies, CC, BCC and attachments are all part of one workspace.

AI prepares, a person sends

Once account access is granted, AI can summarise the conversation and suggest a reply. You can also select part of a message and use it to prepare lead details for review.

Communication channels included

Email, WhatsApp Business, SMS and a helpline are part of the CRM core. We activate accounts according to the team's needs. OLX conversations are part of the additional listings module.

Connection includes a functional test

We verify account access, receiving, replying, attachments, and errors. Simply saving the account does not complete channel implementation.

Check mailbox details

03 / Custom workspace

Your dashboard.
Your cases and priorities.

You rearrange and enlarge tiles, pin cases, and add notes and reminders. The tile size affects the amount of information displayed. You can handle different topics across multiple tabs without losing context.

Amounts concealed in front of clients

Private mode conceals amounts during screen sharing. This facilitates presentations. Access to pricing and data is governed separately by user permissions.

Follow-up contact follows rules

Sequences manage deadlines and reminders. They take into account contact hours, responses received in the CRM, and pauses after sales rep activity. The sending channel for sequences is configured separately from personal mailboxes.

Connections with company tools

Your accounts.
Collaborative work.

In the base package, we connect agreed accounts and numbers via available integrations. Before launch, we verify permissions, inbound and outbound delivery, and linking contacts to cases.

WhatsApp Business
Company number via WhatsApp Business Cloud. Conversations, supported templates and documents linked to the customer.
Play and SerwerSMS
Play Virtual PBX for hotlines and call history. SMS via Play or SerwerSMS gateway.
Resend
System messages, email sending and confirmation of the sending result. Sending domain configuration within the agreed scope.
Company email and Gmail
Mailboxes via IMAP and SMTP. Gmail with an app password, if permitted by account settings and the administrator.
Outlook and Microsoft 365
We connect the mailbox used in Outlook according to its provider. Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com accounts require an additional OAuth connection — this scope is agreed upon before implementation.
Other systems
We check the need and possibility of integration. A new integration can be included in the shared scope at no extra charge if it develops Dopina in a direction beneficial to both parties. We specify the terms in the quote.

Channel connection is included in the CRM package. Operator subscriptions, used SMS messages, calls, Meta services, and other vendor fees are settled according to their terms.

Implementation scope

CRM with communication.
Included in the package from the start.

Before implementation, we define the process, accounts, roles, data to migrate and acceptance scenarios.

CRM Base

First sales process, clients and cases, custom dashboard, email, WhatsApp Business, SMS, hotline, basic sequences, and AI assistance.

Implementation includes adapting the process, connecting agreed accounts, checking operation and preparing the team for work.

Social media + OLX

Extension to include OLX listings and chat management, content preparation, Facebook, and transferring assets to TikTok.

The scope of OLX accounts and categories is confirmed before the quote. This covers tool implementation; ongoing profile management and advertising budgets are billed separately.

Email connection and managementCRM base14

  • IMAP and SMTP connection

    Address, public servers, secure ports, login, and app password. We verify availability with the email provider.

  • Connection check

    Separate login verification for receiving and sending before starting work.

  • Changing access credentials

    Edit the name and replace the password without deleting imported history.

  • Account status

    Information on whether the account is connected and when synchronization took place.

  • Access credential encryption

    The saved password is not displayed again in the form.

  • Receiving from the INBOX folder

    On-demand message fetching without marking them as read in the source mailbox.

  • Controlled history import

    The first import covers the last 25 messages, fetched in batches. We do not assume migrating the entire archive.

  • Resuming download

    Continuation from the saved location and recognition of already fetched messages.

  • New message and reply

    Text message with selection of sender account, recipient, subject, and content. The reply preserves the thread link.

  • CC and BCC

    Additional recipients from the connected email account; up to 5 addresses in each field.

  • Attachments and preview

    Adding and downloading files, plus reviewing messages before sending. Up to 10 files, 15 MB total.

  • Automatic draft saving

    Content, recipients, and attachments saved for the user and conversation, with concurrency control.

  • Duplicate send control

    Recognition of previously handled requests and a clear message when the result requires verification.

  • Import exception handling

    An oversized or unreadable message receives a notice referring to the source mailbox.

AI for cases and messagesCRM base7

  • Conversation summary

    Agreed details and missing information from available contact history.

  • Suggested reply

    Text for review and correction by an employee. Sending from the inbox requires a separate action.

  • Customer context for AI

    Notes, quotes, and fulfilment status available to the person help prepare the reply.

  • Enabling AI separately per account

    The decision to share messages from a given account is independent of other inboxes.

  • Lead from selected excerpt

    A selected excerpt from a message can populate proposed lead data. The employee reviews the form before saving.

Follow-up contact and sequencesCRM base12

  • Steps after stage change

    Email or reminder sequence triggered according to the process configuration.

  • Deadline for each step

    Interval in days, time, and recipient: customer or team member.

  • Templates with enquiry data

    Agreed content populated with customer and quote details.

  • Sequences by qualification

    Different follow-up for someone exploring the offering and a customer close to a decision.

  • Manual and automated steps

    Selected actions wait for execution by an employee; the rest wait for the due date and process conditions.

  • Contact hours and days

    Sending window to the customer, with the option to restrict to working days.

  • Reaction to customer response

    A reply retrieved into the CRM and linked to the enquiry, or a completed call, can pause the sequence. With manually refreshed email, the reply must first be retrieved.

  • Pause after sales rep contact

    Limiting automated messages overlapping with recent employee contact.

  • Resumption after verification

    The case owner can return to the paused flow with shifted deadlines.

  • Unsubscription and process completion

    Stopping automated contacts according to unsubscription or case outcome.

  • Missing data check

    Pausing a step with an unfilled important field or a missing link.

  • History of steps and errors

    It is clear what is pending, completed, cancelled, or requires correction.

Implementation and sign-off

Implementation tailored
to your company's workflow.

First, a specific example

We go through the enquiry, response, quote, and next contact. We define roles, existing tools, and data to be migrated.

Then scope and price

The quote separates implementation, additional modules, provider costs, and maintenance. The timeline is agreed after reviewing integrations and data availability.

Sign-off based on team scenarios

We verify proper access, conversation linking, draft saving, sending and its outcome, as well as sequence reaction to replies. The deployment also covers error scenarios.

See how STAGO uses the system

Before the first conversation.

Do I need all of Dopina right away?

No. We can start with the CRM or the B2B portal. We choose the first process to address a real need of the team. Explore the B2B portal and its scope.

Can I connect Gmail or Microsoft 365 with one click?

We connect Gmail via IMAP and SMTP using an app password if the account allows it. For Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com, an OAuth connection is required, which we agree on before implementation. The Outlook application itself can handle email from various providers. An additional connection does not automatically mean an extra charge.

Does the inbox replace a full email client?

It is used to manage relationships in the CRM. Incoming mail includes INBOX, while archive and tags work inside the CRM. Emails are text-based, and sending history remains in the CRM. A copy in the provider's Sent folder, synchronisation of all folders, message forwarding, and email rules are agreed upon as an additional scope.

Are WhatsApp Business, SMS, and the hotline paid add-on modules?

No. Email, WhatsApp Business, SMS and the phone line are part of the core CRM. We connect agreed accounts through available integrations. We agree on the terms of provider services before implementation.

Does every new integration mean an additional fee?

No. We assess its scope and value for the company and the further development of Dopina. We can include a new connection in the implementation without extra charge. If an additional budget is required, we agree on it before starting work.

Can I connect any WhatsApp using a QR code?

The implementation scope is based on WhatsApp Business Cloud. It requires configuring a number and a Meta account, inbound message handling, and compliant templates. We match the connection method to the company number and handled conversations.

Will AI or a sequence send anything without review?

A suggested response in the inbox waits for user action. Automated sequences are launched separately, with defined content, schedules, and stop rules. A sequence can react to a reply only after it is received in the CRM and linked to the case. With manually fetched mail, this requires refreshing the inbox. Within this scope, sequences send email or SMS; WhatsApp support does not imply automated WhatsApp sequences.

Which social media platforms are covered by the additional module?

Facebook as well as preparing and submitting materials to TikTok. TikTok publishing is completed by the user in the provider's application. Instagram, LinkedIn, and Messenger messaging support are not part of the described connection.

What does the initial implementation include?

The first agreed process and selected features. The proposal records the accounts, migration, integrations, acceptance and support. Further development is agreed separately.

Will Dopina replace accounting or a full ERP?

The CRM scope organizes sales and customer service. Accounting, warehouse, production, and data sources can remain in current tools or receive a separately agreed connection.
